verdict.rationale: Stripe's Payment Links docs say you can create a payment link and share it on social media, in emails, or on your website, with localized language, currency and payment methods for buyers. The tax doc describes collecting tax on Payment Links without writing any code, and the Payment Links page lists no-code refunds, which supports the no-code founder workflow. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that links are created from the Dashboard, evidence on how quickly a new account can go live and start selling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
